parent_objective: plan source-history corpus expansion using the M1322 source repair corpus
blocked_by: M1322 exports a new seven-family source corpus candidate that needs fold planning
supersedes: planning from the old M1273 source corpus

public_gates: M1323 must not use private holdout
M1323 must preserve actor input contract
M1323 must use the M1322 source corpus
M1323 must avoid false materialized-history matches from pair-id collision
M1323 must report coverage gaps instead of fabricating global friction
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
do not use stale M1280 materialized history by pair id

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the M1322 exported source corpus meets expansion planning targets
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: planning infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if plan uses stale materialized histories by pair-id collision
stop if plan hides global friction coverage gap
stop if plan routes directly to PPO
stop if plan changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if plan is admissible, route to source-history materialization design
if plan is near but under target, route to export/coverage audit
if global friction blocks target, route to global-friction source branch
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1322 exports the source repair corpus candidate

blocked_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: planned pair-probe group count is reported
family count and fold balance are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1323 is a corpus plan and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: plan source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If planning targets are missed, report coverage gaps rather than routing to policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1322 source repair corpus can support a materially broader source-history expansion plan while preserving the global-friction blocker and avoiding stale materialized-history matches.
success_criteria: global friction is reported as missing or inactive
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1323 passes as infrastructure if it writes deterministic expansion plan artifacts from M1322 without stale materialized-history matches, hidden global-friction gaps, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
